race.name: all-claims evidence race (T903/T904 lanes)
race.question: for every claim in the register, does the cited evidence actually establish it?
race.coverage: complete - every row of CLAIMS.md §2 judged, none skipped
race.batch_files: untracked/race-allclaims/lane-T904/batch-{1..12}.jsonl (one JSON object per row; batch-4 additionally carries {"revises":"GLOBAL.C2"})
conventions_declared: Verdicts grade the row's OWN evidence column at its STATUS: FALSE rows graded on whether their citations establish the recorded falsification; UNTESTED rows default ADJACENT because their citations record openness, not the proposition.
Research notes that carry measured numbers/denominators are treated as weak-but-real output records (BACKED-medium); pure assertion documents are PROSE-ONLY.
Pure axiom/definition rows are BACKED-as-defined; substantive theorem claims resting only on their own statement (GLOBAL.Z) are ADJACENT.
notable_findings: 4x4.M2 miscitation: cites retrograde-4x4.md:21, which reads '~19 min WALL total' (wall time), not '19 sweeps'; the measurement actually sits uncited at boards/4x4/EPISTEMIC.md:364. Quantity confusion from line drift.

CODE.M4A-HARNESS (PROVEN by inspection) is stale at HEAD and unmarked: build.zig:177-185 now wires oracle_v2_accept tests into test_step, and the corrupted-copy A6 fixtures now exist - its '(a) in no build graph' half no longer holds. Flagged ADJACENT.

The E2 leak chain (GLOBAL.C3/LEAK/P1/P3, 2x2.C3, 3x2.C3, 3x3.C3, GLOBAL.E2-SANITY/E2-VERDICT, 3x3.E2-RUN1/RUN2) is PROSE-ONLY end to end: no raw E2 run output exists anywhere in git. GLOBAL.C3 has the register's highest FALSE in-degree.

Line drift is widespread but content usually survives nearby in the same file; only 4x4.M2's drift crossed into a different quantity.

notes: Leaf lane of a blind race; did not read other lanes' outputs; made no commits; wrote only the batch JSONLs under untracked/race-allclaims/lane-T904/ and this findings file. One mid-race revision issued (GLOBAL.C2 BACKED->PROSE-ONLY) when the strict own-column rule was adopted after batch 3. Weakest where judgement calls had no artifact to open: the axiom-definition convention, and research-note-vs-output-record boundary cases (4x4.FP1-C3, 2x2.F2, 3x3.F2, 4x4.B43) - a stricter lane would call several of these PROSE-ONLY.
